title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Carleton College
description: Ten under-21-safe Northfield food destinations with currently published late hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 410 S Hwy 3, Northfield
cards.notes: Use the drive-through when you need a late food option; the official location page lists service through 1:00 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A daily 1:00 AM drive-through option on Highway 3.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s Northfield location lists drive-through hours of 7:00 AM–1:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is listed open until 1:00 AM daily; dine-in hours differ.

cards.title: Carbone's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 620 S Water St, Northfield
cards.notes: Order food for dine-in, delivery, or takeout; confirm kitchen availability when arriving close to the listed 1:00 AM closing time.
cards.short_summary: Pizza, pasta, and hoagies with the latest listed closing time downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: Carbone’s Northfield lists Monday–Saturday hours of 11:00 AM–1:00 AM and Sunday hours until midnight.
cards.access_notes: Listed open until 1:00 AM Monday–Saturday and midnight Sunday; food offerings are listed on the location page.

cards.title: Applebee's Grill + Bar
cards.subtitle: 2433 Hwy 3 S, Northfield
cards.notes: Use dine-in, pickup, delivery, or Carside To Go for food; its location page publishes midnight restaurant hours every day.
cards.short_summary: A highway restaurant with daily midnight hours and multiple food-ordering options.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee’s Northfield lists restaurant hours of 11:00 AM–12:00 AM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are listed until midnight daily; use food ordering rather than bar service.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: 1101 S Hwy 3, Northfield
cards.notes: Check the official location page before leaving; it lists restaurant and drive-through service until 11:00 PM most nights.
cards.short_summary: A South Highway 3 food stop with published 11:00 PM service.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s at 1101 S Hwy 3 lists lobby hours until 11:00 PM daily, with Friday and Saturday drive-through service until 11:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Lobby closes at 11:00 PM daily; Friday and Saturday drive-through closes at 11:30 PM.

cards.title: Culver's
cards.subtitle: 960 Hwy 3 S, Northfield
cards.notes: Plan for dine-in by 10:00 PM, or use the later drive-through window Wednesday through Saturday when it is listed open to 11:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A drive-through option with later midweek-to-weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver’s Northfield lists dine-in hours until 10:00 PM daily and drive-through hours until 11:00 PM Wednesday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Northfield, MN — Hwy 3 S
cards.access_notes: Dine-in closes at 10:00 PM daily; drive-through is listed until 11:00 PM Wednesday–Saturday.

cards.title: El Tequila
cards.subtitle: 1010 MN-3 S, Northfield
cards.notes: Choose the restaurant’s food service for a later dinner; the official Northfield page lists daily hours ending at 10:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican restaurant on Minnesota 3 with daily 10:00 PM hours.
cards.evidence_claim: El Tequila’s Northfield location lists hours of 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The official Northfield page lists food-service hours until 10:00 PM every day.

cards.title: Pizza Hut
cards.subtitle: 1500 Clinton Ln, Northfield
cards.notes: Use delivery or carryout for a Friday or Saturday food pickup; the official store page lists those services until 10:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A Clinton Lane delivery and carryout option with 10:00 PM weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut at 1500 Clinton Lane lists delivery and carryout hours until 10:00 PM Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout are listed until 10:00 PM Friday and Saturday; other days end at 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Tokyo Grill
cards.subtitle: 1301 Bollenbacher Dr, Northfield
cards.notes: For a later sit-down or takeout meal, go Friday or Saturday; the restaurant’s own site lists service until 9:30 PM.
cards.short_summary: A Bollenbacher Drive restaurant open to 9:30 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Tokyo Grill lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:00 AM–9:30 PM and identifies its Northfield address.
cards.access_notes: Listed open until 9:30 PM Friday and Saturday; Tuesday–Thursday and Sunday close at 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Taco Terco
cards.subtitle: 305 S Water St, Northfield
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s listed Water Street location for dinner; its official menu and location page shows a 9:00 PM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Water Street restaurant with a published 9:00 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Terco’s official location page lists 305 Water Street South, Northfield and says it closes at 9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Taco Terco menu, location, and hours
cards.access_notes: The official location section lists a 9:00 PM close; check the page for day-specific changes.

cards.title: Basil's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 301 S Water St, Northfield
cards.notes: Make this an early-evening pizza run: Carleton’s current Northfield restaurant guide lists Monday–Saturday service ending at 9:00 PM.
cards.short_summary: A long-running local pizza restaurant with published 9:00 PM weeknight and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Carleton’s Northfield restaurant guide lists Basil’s Pizza at 301 Water St S, open Monday–Saturday from 5:00 PM–9:00 PM.
cards.source_title: Carleton College — Cafes, Grocery Stores, and Restaurants in Northfield
cards.access_notes: Carleton’s guide lists hours until 9:00 PM Monday through Saturday; Basil’s own site confirms its Northfield location.
